title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 410 (Constitution of Appellate Tribunal)

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Central Government constitutes the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal to hear appeals against orders of the Tribunal.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: An appeal lies on the grounds in section 421. A further appeal on a question of law lies to the Supreme Court under section 423.
